 Saturday WSL Tips: Two Big Calls at 15/2 and 12/1 
 1 day ago 
 | 
 BY Sam McLoughlin 
 William Hill News tipster  @Footy_Tipster previews Saturday’s Women’s Super League action from across the country. 
 Liverpool v Chelsea Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals (21/10) | Liverpool 0-2 Chelsea (15/2) 
 London City Lionesses v Crystal Palace Prediction: Both Teams To Score (6/5) | London City 4-1 Crystal Palace (12/1) 
 Create your Bet Bui l der now 
 Stack your selections into an accumulator 
 Two Women’s Super League fixtures take place on Saturday, with Chelsea looking to extend their lead at the top of the table.
 The Blues travel to Liverpool for the lunchtime kick-off, before third-placed London City Lionesses welcome Crystal Palace to Bromley in the evening.
 Now, let’s take a closer look at some Women’s Super League odds and betting angles fo r Saturday’s fixtures:
 Liverpool v Chelsea – Saturday, 12.45pm 
 View all available markets at William Hill 
 Liverpool climbed to tenth in the WSL following Saturday’s impressive 3-0 victory at Brighton, ending a five-match winless league run (D1, L4). Gareth Taylor’s side have collected 11 points from ten fixtures (W3, D2, L5), although they’ve won just once in four home matches this season. The Reds held Chelsea to a 1-1 draw here last November, with another home success priced at 6/1 with William Hill for the win.
 Chelsea remain unbeaten in the WSL this season (W8, D2), sitting top with 26 points after Saturday’s 1-0 victory over Manchester City. Sonia Bompastor’s side have scored 29 goals and conceded just five in ten league fixtures, while Wednesday’s Champions League victory over PSG provided another boost. The Blues have also won 17 of their 26 previous WSL meetings with Liverpool, with the visitors available at 3/10 with William Hill to extend that record.
 London City Lionesses v Crystal Palace – Saturday, 5.15pm 
 Think there’s value? See the current price at William Hill 
 London City Lionesses sit third in the WSL with 20 points from ten matches (W6, D2, L2), having scored an impressive 25 goals. Eder Maestre’s side have won four of their five home league fixtures this season, while they also beat Saturday’s opponents 4-2 in October’s League Cup meeting. The hosts will be hoping for a similar outcome, with William Hill pricing London City at 1/9 to claim another three points .
 Crystal Palace head to Bromley sitting 12th with nine points from ten league matches (W2, D3, L5), following last weekend’s 2-0 defeat at Manchester United. The Eagles have conceded 21 goals this season and remain without an away league victory (D3, L2), although they’ve managed to score in three of those five trips. A surprise victory for the visitors can be backed at 18/1 with William Hill .
 *All o dds subject to change – prices accurate at the time of writing*
